sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: When throwing a ball overhand to a partner, where should you look?
options: C) Directly at your partner's chest/target
questions.answer: C) Directly at your partner's chest/target

questions.question_text: Which part of the foot is generally safest and most accurate for a basic short pass in football (soccer)?
options: C) The inside of the foot
questions.answer: C) The inside of the foot

questions.question_text: What does a 'warm-up' do for our body before playing games?
options: A) Makes us tired so we sleep better
B) Prepares our muscles and prevents injuries
D) Cools down our body temperature
questions.answer: B) Prepares our muscles and prevents injuries

questions.question_text: In the traditional game of Pitthou (Lagori), what objects are stacked?
Tadasana is also known by which English name?
When you strike a ball with a bat, what should your feet do?
options: B) Stand shoulder-width apart for balance
questions.answer: B) Stand shoulder-width apart for balance

questions.question_text: Which movement involves taking off on one foot and landing on the SAME foot?
If a teammate makes a mistake during a match, what is the best thing to do?
options: C) Encourage them and say 'Good try!'
questions.answer: C) Encourage them and say 'Good try!'

questions.question_text: During simple meditation or deep breathing, how should your back be?
options: B) Leaning back on a wall completely relaxed
C) Straight and upright but relaxed
questions.answer: C) Straight and upright but relaxed

questions.question_text: Why is it important to drink water (hydration) while playing outdoor games?
options: A) To make our stomach full
B) To replace the water lost through sweat and keep energy up
C) To make us run faster
questions.answer: B) To replace the water lost through sweat and keep energy up

questions.question_text: What is the difference between jumping and skipping?
questions.answer: Jumping involves pushing off the ground with two feet and landing on two feet. Skipping is a continuous pattern of a step and a hop on one foot, then a step and a hop on the other.

questions.question_text: Name two important safety rules you must follow when playing a throwing game with a hard ball.
questions.answer: 1. Never throw the ball when the receiver is not looking or not ready. 2. Do not aim the ball at someone's head or face.

questions.question_text: Describe the posture for Vrikshasana (Tree Pose).
questions.answer: Stand tall on one leg. Bend the other knee and place the sole of that foot on the inner thigh of the standing leg. Join your palms together at your chest or raise them above your head to balance.

questions.question_text: How do you score a point in the game of Kabaddi?
questions.answer: A 'Raider' scores a point by entering the opponent's half, touching one or more defenders while chanting 'Kabaddi' continuously, and returning safely to their own half.

questions.question_text: What should you do immediately if you scrape your knee on the playground and it is bleeding slightly?
questions.answer: I should immediately stop playing, inform the teacher or sports coach, and wash the scrape with clean water and apply an antiseptic/band-aid.

sections.section_name: Section C - Sports Mechanics & Fill in the Blanks

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks regarding basic game literacy: a) The person who ensures the rules are followed in a match is the ____. b) The line that marks the edge of the playing field is called the ____ line. c) Hitting a ball with a racket is an example of ____ the ball.
questions.answer: a) Referee/Umpire, b) Boundary/Sideline, c) Striking.

questions.question_text: Match the Traditional Game to its primary equipment/action: 1) Gilli-Danda, 2) Kho-Kho, 3) Pitthou (Lagori). Options: A) Sitting in a zig-zag line, B) A short wooden peg and a longer stick, C) A soft ball and stacked stones.
questions.answer: 1 -> B (A short wooden peg and a longer stick), 2 -> A (Sitting in a zig-zag line), 3 -> C (A soft ball and stacked stones).

questions.question_text: During a game of football, the ball goes out of bounds. You think your team kicked it out, but your teammate argues that the other team touched it last and demands the ball back. The referee did not see it. How do you handle this situation showing good sportsmanship?
questions.answer: I will calmly tell my teammate that honesty is more important than winning one point. I will step forward and tell the other team and the referee that we touched the ball last, and the other team should get the throw-in. This shows respect for fair play and prevents a bad argument.

questions.question_text: Your Physical Education teacher has asked you to lead a 5-minute cool-down and mindfulness session after a tiring running game. Outline three simple steps or yoga practices you will guide the class through.
questions.answer: Step 1: I will ask everyone to stand in Tadasana (Mountain Pose), keeping their backs straight and taking three slow, deep breaths to slow down their heart rate. Step 2: I will lead them in gentle arm stretches, reaching high to the sky and slowly touching their toes. Step 3: We will sit cross-legged on the ground, close our eyes, and practice 2 minutes of silent deep breathing to relax our minds before going back to the classroom.
